variants.name: 冰火晶体
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / logo-brand exploration. Produce ONE standalone refined desktop app icon, square, with a navy rounded-square tile and genuinely transparent pixels outside the tile. Image 1 is the original identity to preserve: a diagonal infinity loop with one connected outward lead on the left and one on the right. Image 2 is a material/depth reference, not a color reference. Preserve the infinity and both leads, the approximate diagonal orientation and the clean recognizable silhouette. Latest user direction is RED AND BLUE INTERMIXING, the poetic feeling of fire and ice in harmony: warm coral-crimson red is prominent and glacial electric blue flows through and meets it. The two energies should interact continuously across the sculpted object, not look like two unrelated flat halves. Give the center an unmistakable over-under crossing, meaningful thickness, highlights and a restrained contact shadow. Use strong material volume and very clean high-end product-design rendering. Mark about 75 percent of tile width, generous breathing room, frontal tile, no scene. Restrained localized glow only; readable as an app icon at small size. No text, no letters, no labels, no watermark, no people or female figures, no literal flames/snowflakes, no sparks/stars, no surrounding rings, no extra interface or mockup layout. Avoid a predominantly purple or orange result. This is an unselected concept preview, not a production icon.
Material direction A: Solid, richly volumetric optical crystal with smooth rounded cross-section. Coral-red light suffuses the left loop and upper foreground crossing; brilliant icy blue light flows through the right loop and underneath, with nuanced red-blue internal reflections traveling across both loops. The blend is visible in glass transmission and reflections, but keep vivid red and vivid blue recognizable; only a narrow pale mixing highlight at the crossing. Both outer lead tips match the connected light flow. Precise glass bevel, no cloudy neon bloom. Premium sculpted crystal, strongest sense of fluid fire/ice fusion.
